notes: Refined existing stories for clearer contract boundaries, stricter validation, and explicit integration coverage. No new IDs created.

change_log.value: Define canonical trial snapshot schema with strict enums (phase/status), required vs optional fields, URL format constraints, and enforce bidirectional parity between Pydantic models and service output.

Implement extraction and normalization including enum mapping, structured locations (city/state/site), eligibility normalization, and deterministic fallback handling for missing or partial ClinicalTrials.gov fields.
Expose trial snapshot via evaluate_care_facade and tool_router with strict schema validation, error handling for upstream failures, and compatibility with tool-use orchestration.
Render structured trial snapshot in chat UI with consistent grouping (overview, eligibility, locations), stable field ordering, and enforced URL validation via URL Guardian before display.

Develop unit, integration, and contract tests covering schema validation, normalization correctness, facade/API response integrity, UI rendering, URL validation, and null/missing field handling across end-to-end flow.
